# Baseball Through the Years

Explore Major League Baseball history through the Lahman database. Season totals can make shortened years look like home-run collapses; the Home runs page uses home runs per team-game to put those totals in context and show how the rate varies across seasons.

The Sluggers page ranks career home-run leaders, with Barry Bonds at the top with 762, and looks at their years in the game and Bonds' season-by-season totals. Visit the analysis pages in the navbar to explore both stories.
